title: The House Myth That Costs You Fortunes
hook_text: YOUR HOUSE IS NOT AN INVESTMENT

beats.say: Your house isn't your best investment. It's just an expensive place to live.
beats.visual: Cinematic wide shot of a suburban house exterior at dusk, dim warm light in windows, overcast sky, muted colors.

beats.say: Most people forget the hidden costs that quietly drain your bank account every single year.
beats.visual: Close-up of human hands holding a heavy metal front door key, dark background, sharp focus.

beats.say: Property taxes, roof repairs, and interest payments add up to hundreds of thousands of dollars.
beats.visual: Overhead shot of a wooden desk with a black calculator and a pile of crumpled paper receipts, harsh desk lamp light.

beats.say: That's money you'll never see again. It doesn't generate a single dollar of cash flow.
beats.visual: Low-angle shot of a brick chimney against a grey sky, cinematic shadows, slow camera drift.

beats.say: Meanwhile, the S and P 500 historically crushes real estate after you subtract all those maintenance fees.
beats.visual: Macro close-up of a brass house key resting on a dark glass table, reflection of a window, shallow depth of field.

beats.say: Let's look at the actual math. If you take that extra cash and invest it instead...
beats.visual: Side silhouette of a person sitting at a kitchen table by a window, blurred background, moody lighting.

beats.say: Investing $500 a month at 8% a year for 30 years grows to a staggering $745,180.
beats.visual: Close-up of a finger tracing a line on a blank white ledger page, grainy film look, soft backlight.

beats.say: Try pulling cash out of your living room wall to pay the grocery bill. You can't.
beats.visual: Cinematic shot of a white painted interior drywall corner, soft shadow, minimalist aesthetic.

beats.say: A house is shelter first. Treat it like a piggy bank and you'll miss out on massive gains.
beats.visual: Wide shot of an empty hardwood room, single dust mote in a beam of afternoon light, still camera.

beats.say: Stop confusing consumption with wealth creation. Buy the home for your family, but build your future in...
beats.visual: Close-up of a person's hands locking a heavy deadbolt from the inside, dark hallway, tight framing.

caption: Your home is shelter first. Stop calling it an investment when the maintenance eats the returns. #realestate #moneyhacks #wealthbuilding #personalfinance #investing
description: Everyone says your home is your best investment. They're missing the maintenance, taxes, and opportunity cost that destroy your returns.
first_comment: Would you rather rent and invest the difference, or buy a house? Let's talk numbers.
